materials_exhausted.note: Bounded local recovery reopened XML, PDF text, OA package NXML/PDF/images/PPTX, supplementary landing HTML, archive manifest, and linked APD6 rows. The ticket blocker was recoverable from local material; no blocking unrecoverable gaps remain.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: The APD6 literature link is source-verified. The APD6 experiment/comment row is preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized with source-supported activity rows and explicit cautions for modified sequence and unsupported hemolysis wording.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered source-supported MIC/MIC50, VRE inhibition, combination, synthetic-backbone negative-control, and human cell-line no-inhibition rows from XML/PDF/PPTX local materials; no database-only activity row is masquerading as primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism ontology is limited to structural identity, phenotype-level activity, metal/siderophore transport hypothesis, and host-cell toxicity context; no unsupported direct intracellular target mechanism is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: The original ticket is resolved after source review and strict gate rerun can close it as accepted_with_cautions rather than clean acceptance.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 itself warns the sequence is a close mimic; primary source identifies delftibactin A structure and shows the unmodified synthetic backbone peptide is inactive up to 1 mg/mL.

APD6 activity values are mostly supported after source review, but hemolysis wording is not promoted as a delftibactin A hemolysis assay and P. aeruginosa is corrected to the paper-supported MIC50 32-64 µg/mL.
Iron/gallium and Delftia D-2189 experiments support metal/siderophore transport context, but the paper does not directly prove transporter uptake or intracellular target.
The eight landed supplementary .bin files are Frontiers landing HTML; the true local supplementary data file was recovered and parsed from the OA package PPTX.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered the missing activity/toxicity rows and re-adjudicated APD6 modified-sequence evidence. The paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions with the modified-sequence/database-comment and mechanism-hypothesis cautions preserved.
adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 source re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001. The paper is accepted_with_cautions: primary XML/PDF/PPTX support the activity/toxicity rows, APD6 modified-sequence evidence is caution-bearing rather than clean source_verified sequence, and mechanism claims remain bounded to source-supported structural/activity/metal-transport context.
